description: Every prediction case of the prediction spec (revision 28) section 6.5 as calls on the fixture roots, with the hand-written expectations. Generated by conformance/tools/build_fixtures.py; do not edit. Steps with "strict" take their numbers from the reference engine's strict mode (KP1-H writes predict_expected.json); K2b-pin merges both into conformance/cases/predict-*.json.

interface.band_coverage: scientific_gate_ready is false while any declared designed-ripple step awaits KP1-H native band proof. K2b-pin must not accept the complete scientific gate until those dependencies are proven. A deferred step is not a band exception.
interface.band_exception: The two revision 29 section 6.3 cases carry their exact registry declaration. K2b-pin must preserve it and compare paired whole-second RFC 3339 UTC event times as integral Unix seconds within 1 s. Counts, order, types and metadata stay exact; heights and other numeric tolerances stay unchanged. The negative case copies strict expected times via swap_of, swaps types and negates heights.
interface.case: {id, title, spec, root, release, requires, steps, runners?, open_args?, note?, band_exception?}. root is a fixture root (fixtures.json); requires are runner features; runners (K2's case-level filter) are the only runners or profiles that run the case; open_args are matrix.open_args.
interface.compare: {entry, args, time_s, height_m}: a second strict computation the step's items must equal within these tolerances (subordinate-folded-extremes: the event method of 4.8, spec 4.8a).
interface.expect_if_missing: An ordered list of [feature, expectation] pairs: K2's driver takes the first feature the runner lacks, so K2b-pin writes them as an object in this order (predict-local/not-built: localtime_module before localtime, since a runner without the module lacks both).
interface.k2: The ops, their arguments and their results are K2's (conformance/driver.py OPS and conformance/README.md "Operations" and "Result encodings" at K2 343fbe3): prediction results are {prediction: Prediction}, datums {datums: DatumInfo or [DatumInfo]}, ranges {ranges: Ranges}, astro_table {astro_table: {first_year, last_year} or null}, the astro functions {value}, valid_range {first_year, last_year}. The case-level runners filter and "localtime implies localtime_module" are K2's too.
interface.outcome: Hand-written outcomes the spec fixes exactly, which K2b-pin checks against the strict items before it pins them: {count: n} (the number of items), or {items: [{time, type}]} (exactly these, in order), optionally with types: [...] (compare only the items of those types).
interface.prediction_fields: station_id, timezone, method, set_id, convention_id, astro_table_id, reference_station_id, reference_bin, datum, datum_name, datum_kind, datum_uncertainty_m, bin_number, omitted_event_types, tz, tz_version, release, algorithm. Readings of 5.3 for revision 29: datum is the argument, null when absent; datum_name is the resolved level's key (mean_level by default for a harmonic tide; for offsets the subordinate datum's chart_datum key, null when it has none); datum_kind and datum_uncertainty_m are that level's basis kind and uncertainty, null for mean_level, zero, or no basis; omitted_event_types is null except at a subordinate current station.
interface.same_items_as_step: The step's items equal that step's (heights-fractional-instants: the floored instants).
interface.step: {op, args, expect?, expect_if_missing?, strict, outcome?, compare?, local?, same_items_as_step?, swap_of?} or a driver step ({driver: restart_runner, env}) or {op: open, matrix_open}. expect is what the driver compares, in K2's encoding: a prediction step's expect.prediction holds every Prediction field except items, which K2b-pin takes from the strict mode (each item with local_time and utc_offset_s null unless to_local), or items when they are written here (an empty window). An expect with error and a non-null strict is a modelled refusal: the case harness checks that the strict mode raises the same code.

strict.crosscheck: scan_5s (extremes: all events against the sign changes of h'; current events: the max_* events against W' and the slack_* events against W), scan_5s_peaks (the max_* events only, against W'), scan_5s_slacks (the slack_* events only, against W): the 5 s brute-force count of spec 6.1 that must equal the count
strict.entries: webcaltides lib/harmonics_strict.rb (237446c) Engine methods: predict_strict(constituents, times, datum_term:), extremes_strict(constituents, start, stop, datum_term:), currents_strict(bin, times), current_events_strict(bin, start, stop), subordinate_extremes_strict(ref_constituents, chart_datum_term, offsets, start, stop, datum_shift:), subordinate_current_events_strict(ref_bin, offset, start, stop); and two compositions: folded_heights = subordinate_folded_strict(ref_constituents, chart_datum_term, offsets, datum_shift:) then predict_strict on its constituents and datum_term at times; folded_extremes = the same then extremes_strict over start, stop. {same_as_step: i}: the strict items of step i (to_local).
strict.references: {$set: set_id} is that set's constituents; {$bin: [set_id, bin]} that bin object; {$offsets: station_id} the station's subordinate_offsets; {$current_offset: [station_id, bin]} that current_offsets entry; astro is the astro_tables entry with that id, passed as astro: Strict::AstroTable.from_h(entry). All in the case's root.

interface.swap_of: {case, step}: the items are that step's with high and low swapped and each height negated (extremes-negative-amplitude; the strict mode refuses a negative amplitude).
interface.times: RFC 3339 UTC strings YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS(.fff)Z; a naive datetime has no Z (Python only). Result times are whole seconds YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.
interface.to_local: A to_local step converts the result of the case's most recent prediction step (K2): args {tz} (absent = the station's zone). Its expect.prediction has tz, the resolved zone name, and tz_version, a version or null. strict.same_as_step names the step whose strict items it converts; local.zone is the zone K2b-pin uses to add local_time and utc_offset_s; local.check lists hand-written values they must equal.
